name: claude-team-sync
description: Share Claude Code session handoffs across the team via a git-hosted CSV and feed them back into Claude's context.

teamSync.repoUrl.description: Git URL of this project's team-sync repo. Commit it in .vscode/settings.json so the team shares it.

teamSync.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI.
